facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet: a large hero image at the top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle, and four detail close-ups at the bottom.
The hero panel shows a person standing with feet apart on a rain-soaked rooftop walkway at night, arms at their sides and head turned toward the left side of the frame.
The person wears a black collared tactical jacket over a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The person has short hair with shaved sides and a small topknot or bun at the crown.
In the FACE close-up, a diagonal scar is visible over the person's right eyebrow area.
The middle row contains three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK, with the figure standing straight against a dark studio-like backdrop.
Visible panel labels read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The bottom row shows close-ups: FACE with a neutral expression, JACKET COLLAR with a strap and buckle, HANDS with visible veins, and BOOTS showing black lace-up combat boots.
The hero background includes wet reflective pavement, dark metal railings, building facades, and blurred warm city lights.
Rain streaks are visible in the hero panel, and the scene is lit in cool blue-gray tones with warm amber highlights.
